verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms llama.cpp ships a `llama serve` backend server mode (gh-2, gh-3) that could serve as an inference backend, but the pack contains no explicit documentation of OpenAI-compatible API endpoints, agent-specific integration guides, or hands-on reports of coding agents (e.g. Cursor, Continue, Aider) successfully using llama.cpp as a backend. Missing for 10: explicit API-compatibility docs, agent-integration examples, and independent confirmation of a coding agent working against the server.
